summary: KB Financial Group filed a Form 6-K (foreign private issuer report) announcing a board resolution to cancel ~3.998 million common shares (KRW 700 billion implied value at ~KRW 175,100/share) acquired via open-market purchases through Samsung Securities from July 24 to December 16, 2026. The cancellation reduces shares outstanding without reducing paid-in capital, structured under Korean Commercial Code Article 343-1. This capital-return event increases per-share metrics, with no tender premium, regulatory triggers, or advisor appointments. Watch execution pace and any subsequent buyback program expansions.
